title: Charcuterie Dipping Oil
summary: Chunky olive oil and balsamic loaded with salami, olives, cheese and herbs; a charcuterie board for bread.
difficulty_reason: Just chop and stir everything in one bowl; no cooking.

ingredients.line: 1/4 cup crumbled soft white cheese such as feta
1 crusty loaf, torn or sliced, for dipping

steps: Pour the olive oil into a wide shallow bowl, then pour the balsamic vinegar into the middle.
Finely chop the salami, olives and gherkins on a cutting board.
Grate the hard cheese and crumble the soft cheese.
Roughly chop the basil and parsley.
Add everything to the bowl and stir until the oil is full of chunky bits.
Serve right away with crusty bread for dipping, spooning plenty of the chunky bits onto each piece.
tips: Chop everything small so each scoop of bread picks up some of every ingredient.
Use a good, fruity olive oil since it is the base of the whole dip.
